νύκτάς: νύξ — night; fem. acc. pl., accusative of time: ’by night’
ξύλα: ξύλον — wood, firewood; neut. acc. pl.

οἴνῳ: οἶνος — wine; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with wine’

οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even

οὖδας: οὖδας — ground, earth, floor; neut. acc. sg.

πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάντῃ: πάντῃ — everywhere, in every direction; adv. (dat. fem. of πᾶς)
πάτρης: πάτρη (Attic πάτρα) — fatherland, native land; gen. sg., Ionic η for Attic ᾱ
πάϊς: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic παῖς)
πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object: ’grief’
πέρην: πέρην — across, on the far side; adv., used as prep. + gen.: ’across from’
παλάμῃσιν: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις): ’in the hands’

παῖδας: παῖς — child, son; masc. acc. pl.

που: που — somewhere, anywhere; perhaps, I suppose; enclitic adv.
πρίαμος: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
πριάμοιο: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)

πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’

σβέσαν: σβέννυμι — quench, put out; aor. 3 pl. act., epic -αν, unaugmented (= Attic ἔσβεσαν): ’they quenched’
σεῦ: σύ — you; gen. sg., epic σεῦ (= Attic σοῦ)
σκοποὶ: σκοπός — lookout, watcher; masc. nom. pl.
σοῖς: σός — your, yours; masc. dat. pl.
στενάχοντο: στενάχομαι (στενάχω) — groan, lament; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented: ’they groaned’

τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τιμήν: ’whatever’ (ἥν τιν’ ἔοικεν ’whatever is fitting’)

τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. acc. sg. as antecedent of a relative: ’the man (who)’ (τὸν μὲν … ὅς κε ’the man who’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a participle: ’the (man) who’ (τὸν προὔχοντα ’the one ahead’) · also masc. acc. sg., article-like with an adjective and noun: ’the’ (τὸν δεξιὸν ἵππον ’the right-hand horse’) · also τὸν ἑόν, ’his own’ (τὸν ἑόν … Πόδαργον ’his own Podargus’)
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)
τῆμος: τῆμος — then, at that time; correlative temporal adv. answering ἦμος ’when’
τῇσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ταῖς): ’for them’ · also fem. dat. pl., after παρά: ’with them’
τῇσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ταῖς): ’to them, among them’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι) · also neut. dat. sg., demonstrative before a relative: ’that’ (τῷ ἴκελον οἷον ’like that which’) · also relative, masc. dat. sg.: ’at whom’ (τῷ ἐφέηκα ’at whom I let fly’) · also neut. dat. sg., object of πίσυνος: ’trusting in it’
φάνη: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφάνη): ’appeared’
φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (bride)’
φίλος: φίλος — dear, beloved; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’dear (to him)’ · also attributive, ’dear’ (φίλος υἱός ’dear son’) · also masc. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (Menelaus)’
χέοντες: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’shedding’
χέουσα: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’pouring, shedding’
χήρην: χήρα — widow; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic χήραν), predicate: ’a widow’ · also fem. acc. sg., attributive with μητέρα: ’widowed’ (μητέρα χήρην ’widowed mother’)
χειρὸς: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. sg.; χειρὸς ἑλόντε ’taking by the hand’ (gen. of the part seized) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἀπό in tmesis: ’from the hand’ (ἀπ’ … χειρὸς ὀμόργνυ) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἐκ in tmesis: ’out of the hand’ (ἐκ … χειρὸς σπάσσατο ’wrenched out of the hand’) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation after ἀπό: ’from the hand’ (ἐμῆς ἀπὸ χειρὸς ’from my hand’) · also fem. gen. sg. after διά: ’through the hand’ (διὰ χειρός)
χεύαντες: χέω — pour; heap up (a mound); aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having heaped up’
χρυσείην: χρύσειος — golden, of gold; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κυνέην
χωόμενος: χώομαι — be angry, be enraged; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ψυχὴν: ψυχή — soul, life-breath; fem. acc. sg.
ἀάσχετον: ἀάσχετος — unrestrainable, irresistible (sense inferred, from ἀ- + ἔχω); adj., neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος
ἀγανοῖς: ἀγανός — gentle, soothing; masc./neut. dat. pl., attributive: ἀγανοῖς ἐπέεσσιν ’with gentle words’
ἀγχοῦ: ἀγχοῦ — near, close by; adv. (by-form of ἄγχι)
ἀδελφεὸν: ἀδελφεός — brother (epic form = Attic ἀδελφός); masc. acc. sg.
ἀεικέα: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful, unfitting; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. pl. · also fem. acc. sg. (adj. of two endings), agreeing with λώβην: ’unseemly (insult)’
ἀλέξανδρος: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἀλίαστον: ἀλίαστος — unceasing, relentless (rare; sense traditional); adj., acc. sg. · also adverbial acc. sg.: ’relentlessly’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλόχους: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. pl.
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀνδρομάχη: Ἀνδρομάχη — Andromache, wife of Hector, daughter of Eëtion; fem. nom. sg.
ἀνδροφόνοιο: ἀνδροφόνος — man-slaying; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
ἀπείρων: ἀπείρων — boundless, endless; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἄπειρος)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’) · also + a form in -θεν, ablatival: ’from’ (ἀπὸ Τροίηθεν ’from Troy’)
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀργυρότοξος: ἀργυρότοξος — of the silver bow; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Apollo
ἀρητὸν: ἀρητός — accursed, cursed (from ἀρή; some take it as ’prayed-for’); masc. acc. sg.
ἀσύφηλον: ἀσύφηλος — sense not known; the traditional gloss is ’insulting, disgraceful’; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’disgracefully’ (or masc. acc., predicative with a person)
ἀτρυγέτοιο: ἀτρύγετος — unharvested, barren (epithet of the sea; meaning uncertain); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg.
ἁδινοῦ: ἁδινός — thronging, thick-set, close-packed; adj., masc. gen. sg.
ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg. · also ἅλς (masc.) — salt; masc. gen. sg., partitive: ’of salt’
ἄγαγε: ἄγω — lead, bring; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤγαγε)
ἄγοντι: ἄγω — lead, bring; pres. part. act. masc. dat. sg.: ’leading’
ἄκουσα: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἤκουσα), + gen. of the person heard
ἄκρης: ἄκρος — topmost, high; adj., fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ᾱς), agreeing with πόλιος: ’of the high (city)’ · also fem. gen. sg., agreeing with Περγάμου: ’high’ (κατὰ Περγάμου ἄκρης ’down from high Pergamos’) (or the noun ἄκρη ’height’, with Περγάμου depending on it) · also fem. gen. sg. in κατ’ ἄκρης, with no noun expressed: ’from the top down, utterly’
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄλοχός: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
ἄμαξαν: ἄμαξα — wagon, cart; fem. acc. sg.
ἄμμορον: ἄμμορος — without share, ill-fated, luckless; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg., of a woman
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄξετε: ἄγω — lead, bring; fut. 2 pl. used as a command: ’bring!’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄσπετον: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, vast beyond telling (ἀ- + root of ’say’); adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with κῦδος: ’boundless’ · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beyond measure, boundlessly’
ἄστεος: ἄστυ — city, town; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic ἄστεως)
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἐΰτροχον: ἐΰτροχος — well-rolling, with good wheels (Attic εὔτροχος); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἅρμα · also fem. acc. sg. (adj. of two endings), agreeing with ἄμαξαν: ’well-wheeled (wagon)’
ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’were born’ · also ’came to be, got (on one’s way)’ (πρὸ ὁδοῦ ἐγένοντο ’got well on the road’) · also aor. 3 pl. with a predicate: ’became, fell’ (ἀκὴν ἐγένοντο ’fell silent’)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’) · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’) · also dat. with μάχομαι: ’against me’ (ἐμοὶ μάχεσθαι ’to fight me’)
ἐμοὺς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. acc. pl.
ἐμῆς: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. gen. sg.
ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg. · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with κάρητι: ’my own’ · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with δουρί: ’my’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐννῆμαρ: ἐννῆμαρ — for nine days; adv. (ἐννέα + ἦμαρ)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’ · ἐκ — in ἐξ ἄλλων (ἐκ + gen.), ’from among the others, more than the rest’
ἐξέλετο: ἐξαιρέω — take out, take away; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἐξείλετο), with acc. and dat. of the person deprived: ’took away (from)’
ἐξέφερον: ἐκφέρω — carry out, bear out; impf. 3 pl. act., augmented after the preverb: ’were bearing out’
ἐξῆρχε: ἐξάρχω — lead off, lead the way, begin (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg.
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’) · also + dat. of aim: ’for, with a view to’ (ἐπ’ ἀρωγῇ ’for help’) · also + dat. of cause: ’at’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ γέλασσαν ’laughed at him’)
ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπέσχε: ἐπέχω — hold back, check, restrain; aor. 3 sg. act. (strong aorist ἐπέσχον): ’checked’ · also ’cover, extend over’, of space: ’covered’ (ἑπτὰ … ἐπέσχε πέλεθρα ’covered seven plethra’)
ἐπέτελλε: ἐπιτέλλω — lay charge on, enjoin (+ dat. + inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’laid charge’
ἐπίσκοπος: ἐπίσκοπος — watcher, scout, overseer; masc. nom. sg., predicate, with dat. of what is watched: ’a scout for (our ships)’
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐποιχόμενος: ἐποίχομαι — go against, assail, come upon; pres. part. mid. dep. masc. nom. sg.: ’assailing, going about’
ἐπὴν: ἐπήν — when, whenever (= ἐπεὶ ἄν; Attic ἐπάν); conj. + subj. · also + opt. in a temporal clause: ’when’ (ἐπὴν τεισαίμεθα ’when we have avenged’)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
ἐρικυδέα: ἐρικυδής — very glorious, splendid; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἐρικυδῆ), with δῶρα
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’) · also + gen., with δόμον understood: ’to the house of’ (ἐς Πριάμοιο ’to Priam’s’)
ἐφάνη: φαίνω — show; pass. appear; aor. pass. 3 sg., augmented (beside unaugmented φάνη): ’appeared’
ἐϋκνήμιδες: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, epithet of the Achaeans; masc. nom./voc. pl.
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑκάβη: Ἑκάβη — Hecuba, wife of Priam; fem. nom. sg.
ἑλένη: Ἑλένη — Helen, wife of Menelaus; fem. nom. sg.
ἑλόντες: αἱρέω — take, capture; aor. part. act., masc. nom. pl.: ’having taken’
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’
ἑοῦ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive, epic enlarged ἑός) — his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. ἑοῦ, agreeing with παιδός · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with πατρός: ’his own’ (ἑοῦ … πατρός ’of his own father’)
ἑτάροιο: ἕταρος — comrade, companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of cause after a verb of anger · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of cause after ἄχος: ’for the comrade’ (ἄχος … ἑτάροιο ’grief for the comrade’) · also masc. gen. sg., possessive, dependent on χερσί: ’of the companion’ · also masc. gen. sg., possessive, with ὀστέα: ’of the companion’ (ἑτάροιο ὀστέα ’the companion’s bones’)
ἔβαλον: βάλλω — throw, cast, put down; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they cast out’ · also ’hit, strike’: ’they struck’ · also σὺν … ἔβαλον in tmesis (= συνέβαλον): ’they joined, brought together’ (σὺν … ἔβαλον πόλεμον ’joined war’) · also ἐν … ἔβαλον in tmesis: ’they put in’ (χαλινοὺς γαμφηλῇς ἔβαλον ’put the bits in the jaws’)
ἔγρετο: ἐγείρω — wake, rouse; aor. 3 sg. mid., 2nd aorist, epic (sense of Attic ἠγέρθη): ’awoke’
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔθηκας: τίθημι — put, make; aor. 2 sg. (κ-aorist): ’you made (it so-and-so)’
ἔκτανεν: κτείνω — kill; aor. 3 sg. act., epic 2nd aor. ἔκτανε(ν) (= Attic ἔκτεινε): ’killed’
ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔνθά: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπεφνες: φένω (aor. ἔπεφνον) — slay; aor. 2 sg., epic reduplicated aorist
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; prep. + acc., accented ἔς before an enclitic
ἔσκε: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, iterative -σκ- form: ’was, used to be’
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔφατο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἔφη): ’he spoke’
ἔχεαν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 pl., ε-stem aorist with -α endings (ἔχεα): ’they poured in’
ἔχες: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 2 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχες): ’you had’
ἔχουσα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκτορ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. voc. sg., in address · also masc. acc. sg., epic elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορα), object of σχήσουσι: ’Hector’ (πελώριον Ἕκτορ’ ’huge Hector’) · also masc. dat. sg., elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορι), after ἅμα: ’with Hector’ (ἅμ’ Ἕκτορ’ ἴσαν ’went with Hector’)
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλον: αἱρέω — take; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλον); ἐκ … ἕλον in tmesis ’picked out’ · also aor. 1 sg. (same -ον ending): ’I took away’ · also in battle: ’killed’ (ἕλον ἄνδρα ’killed a man’) · also aor. 3 pl. with ὀδάξ: ’bit’ (ὀδὰξ ἕλον οὖδας ’bit the ground’)
ἠέλιον: ἥλιος — sun; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted ἠέλιον (= Attic ἥλιον)
ἠγερέθοντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; impf. mid. 3 pl., epic -εθ- formation (= Attic ἠγείροντο): ’were gathering’
ἠριγένεια: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
ἡμιόνους: ἡμίονος — mule; masc. acc. pl.; accent from the enclitic τε
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’) · also ’than’ after φθάνω ’be first’ (φθήσονται … ἢ ὑμῖν ’will tire sooner than you’) · also ’rather than’ after βούλομαι (βουλοίμην … ἢ … ’I would rather … than …’)
ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’) · also ἤ = ἦ, interrogative particle opening a direct question: ’can it be that …?’ (ἤ ῥ’ ἔτι που σχήσουσι … ’can they still, I wonder, hold back …?’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or adverb of degree (ἤ περ ’than’) · also ἤ … ἦ, introducing a deliberative alternative: ’(shall I) … or …’ (ἤ μιν … θείω … ἦ … δαμάσσω) · also ἤ = ἦ with μοι in a self-addressed question: ’why indeed …?’ (τί ἤ μοι)
ἤγερθεν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -εν (= Attic ἠγέρθησαν): ’were gathered’
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
ἤπιος: ἤπιος — gentle, kindly; masc. nom. sg.
ἥατο: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; impf. 3 pl., epic -ατο (= Attic ἧντο): ’were sitting’
ἥβην: ἥβη — youth, prime of youth; fem. acc. sg. · also Ἥβη — Hebe, goddess of youth; fem. acc. sg.
ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj. (epic)
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule, lead; impf. 3 sg., absolute: ’led the way’ · also + gen. of the people or ships led: ’was leading’ (τῶν ἦρχε … νεῶν) · also + gen. of what is begun: ’began, led off’ (μύθων ἦρχε ’led off the talk’) · also + dat. of the troops led: ’led’ (ἦρχε … σφιν ’led them’)
ἱπποδάμοιο: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming (standing epithet); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἴκελος: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, befall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.
ἵξεσθαι: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, arrive at; fut. inf. mid./dep. (ἵξομαι), in indirect statement after ἔφαντο: ’that he would come’ · also after ἔμελλεν: ’was about to reach’
ὀδύρονται: ὀδύρομαι — lament, wail; pres. 3 pl.: ’they lament’
ὀδὰξ: ὀδάξ — with the teeth, biting; adv.
ὀλέσθαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish; aor. inf. mid.: ’to perish’
ὀστέα: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστᾶ)
ὁμηγερέες: ὁμηγερής — gathered together, assembled; masc. nom. pl.
ὁπόσσον: ὁπόσος (epic ὁπόσσος) — as great as, how much; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’as far as’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐπήρκεσε · also masc. acc. sg., object of βούλευσαν and of φύγοι: ’destruction’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of μαντεύεαι: ’destruction’
ὄρινε: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse; impf./aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤρινε): ’stirred’ · ὀρίνω — pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’stir up!’
ὅμιλος: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng, gathering; nom. sg.
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’whom’ · also ὅς τις in an indirect question, masc. acc. sg.: ’what’ (νόον ὅν τιν’ ἔχουσιν ’what mind they have’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’) · also ὅς (τε) as an indirect interrogative without τις: ’who’ (ὅς τε πεφεύγοι ’who had fled’) · also ὅς τις, indefinite relative + fut. indic.: ’whoever’ (ὅς τις … οἴσεται ’whoever will carry off’) · also ὅς τις, indefinite relative + opt.: ’whoever’ (ὅς τις … πέλοιτο ’whoever should prove’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also ὡς ὅτε, introducing a simile: ’as when’
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’) · also + gen. of the cause, ’before, at the onslaught of’ (ὑπ’ Ἀχιλλῆος ’before Achilles’) · also + a φιν-form: ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὄχεσφιν ’under the chariots’)
ὑπάτῃ: ὕπατος — uppermost, topmost; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with πυρῇ
ὕλην: ὕλη — wood, timber, brushwood; fem. acc. sg. · also Ὕλη — Hyle, a Boeotian town; fem. acc. sg.
ὕπερθε: ὕπερθε(ν) — above, from above, on top; adv.
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤφελλον: ὀφέλλω (= ὀφείλω) — owe; ought; impf. 1 sg., augmented, + inf. in an unfulfilled wish: ’would that I had been’
ὧδ: ὧδε — thus, so, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ὧς: ὥς — thus, so; adv. (printed ὧς, = ὣς; Attic οὕτως)
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with which’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., of the person affected: ’about whom’ (ᾧ … περὶ ῥόπαλ’ ἐάγῃ ’about whom clubs are broken’) · also relative, neut. dat. sg., object of ἐπέπιθμεν: ’in which’ (ᾧ ἐπέπιθμεν ’in which we trusted’) · also relative, masc./neut. dat. sg., with πέρι: ’around which’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., two-ending adj., epithet of Dawn
